q: 列出所有用户的姓名。
expected: SELECT name FROM users

q: 有哪些商品分类？
expected: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products

q: 库存少于10的商品叫什么？
expected: SELECT name FROM products WHERE stock < 10

q: 把用户表里北京的用户列出来。
expected: SELECT * FROM users WHERE city = '北京'

q: 商品里价格最高的是哪个？
expected: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

q: 订单一共有多少条？
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

q: 有哪些支付方式？
expected: SELECT DISTINCT method FROM payments

q: 每个城市各有多少用户？
expected: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city

q: 已支付订单的总金额是多少？
expected: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments

q: 平均每笔支付多少钱？
expected: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payments

q: 一共卖出多少件商品？
expected: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

q: 最贵的一笔支付是多少？
expected: SELECT MAX(amount) FROM payments

q: 每种支付方式各有多少笔？
expected: SELECT method, COUNT(*) FROM payments GROUP BY method

q: 每个分类下有多少种商品？
expected: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

q: 哪个商品被买得最多？
expected: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

q: 去掉重复后一共有多少个城市有用户？
expected: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM users

q: 单价高于100的商品平均价格是多少？
expected: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE price > 100

q: 被取消的订单有哪些？
expected: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

q: 金额超过1000的支付记录列出来。
expected: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE amount > 1000

q: 名字里带'红'字的用户有谁？
expected: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%红%'

q: 价格在100到500之间的商品有哪些？
expected: SELECT * FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 100 AND 500

q: 库存为0的商品一共有几件？
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock = 0

q: 退款状态的订单有多少条？
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded'

q: 上个月的订单总额是多少？
expected: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND paid_at < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')

q: 最近7天新增了多少用户？
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

q: 今年的支付总额是多少？
expected: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE YEAR(paid_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())

q: 上个月每天新增多少订单？
expected: SELECT DATE(created_at), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND created_at < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE(created_at)

q: 3月份的取消订单有几条？
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE MONTH(created_at) = 3 AND status = 'cancelled'

q: 今天已经付了款的订单有哪些？
expected: SELECT o.* FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE DATE(p.paid_at) = CURDATE()

q: 昨天一天卖出了多少件商品？
expected: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE DATE(o.created_at) = CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

q: 最近30天每个城市的成交额排行。
expected: SELECT u.city, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE p.paid_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY total DESC

q: 每个用户各下了多少单？
expected: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id

q: 买过商品名带'壳'的商品的用户有谁？
expected: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%壳%'

q: 每个分类的销售总额是多少？
expected: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: 从来没用过订单的用户有哪些？
expected: SELECT * FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

q: 订单1001里买了哪些商品？
expected: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 1001

q: 用支付宝付过款的用户有哪些？
expected: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.method = '支付宝'

q: 哪个商品卖得最好？
expected: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

q: 哪些商品快没货了？
expected: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock < 5

q: 现在拉新情况怎么样？
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')

q: 帮我看看上个月生意好不好。
expected: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND o.created_at < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
note: 口语汇总（单量+销售额，容许多解）
